test_cases.scenario: Skills page loads for authenticated user with view permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as a user with skills.view_skill permission. Navigate to /skills/.
test_cases.expected: Page loads successfully. Skill list table is visible. No errors in browser console.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated user is redirected to login
test_cases.steps: Log out. Navigate directly to /skills/.
test_cases.expected: User is redirected to /login/. Skills page is not accessible.

test_cases.scenario: Add button is visible only for user with add_skill permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as user with skills.add_skill permission. Navigate to /skills/.
test_cases.expected: Add Skill button is visible in the page header.

test_cases.scenario: Add button is hidden for user without add_skill permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as user without skills.add_skill permission. Navigate to /skills/.
test_cases.expected: Add Skill button is not visible on the page.

test_cases.scenario: Import button is visible only for user with import_skill permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as user with skills.import_skill permission. Navigate to /skills/.
test_cases.expected: Import button is visible on the page.

test_cases.scenario: Export button is visible only for user with export_skill permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as user with skills.export_skill permission. Navigate to /skills/.
test_cases.expected: Export button is visible on the page.

test_cases.scenario: Edit and delete actions are hidden for user without change/delete permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as user with only skills.view_skill permission. Navigate to /skills/. Inspect table row actions.
test_cases.expected: No edit or delete action buttons are visible on skill rows.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned. Response body contains a structured error.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without view_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/ with a valid Bearer token for a user who does not have skills.view_skill permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Default list returns only active skills
test_cases.steps: Ensure both active and inactive skills exist. Send GET /api/v1/skills/ with a valid Bearer token and view_skill permission.
test_cases.expected: Response contains only active skills (is_active=true). Inactive skills are not included.

test_cases.scenario: Response includes standard pagination envelope
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response body contains: success, message, data.results (array), data.pagination with total_count, total_pages, current_page, page_size, has_next, has_previous.

test_cases.scenario: Search by skill name returns matching skills only
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/?search=Python with a valid token. At least one skill with 'Python' in its name exists.
test_cases.expected: Only skills whose skill field contains 'Python' (case-insensitive) are returned.

test_cases.scenario: Search with no matches returns empty results
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/?search=ZZZNOMATCH with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: results is an empty array. pagination.total_count is 0.

test_cases.scenario: is_active=false filter returns inactive skills
test_cases.steps: Ensure at least one inactive skill exists. Send GET /api/v1/skills/?is_active=false with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response contains only inactive skills (is_active=false).

test_cases.scenario: Sort by skill name ascending
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/?sort=skill&order_by=ASC with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Skills are returned in alphabetical order A→Z by skill name.

test_cases.scenario: Sort by skill name descending
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/?sort=skill&order_by=DESC with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Skills are returned in reverse alphabetical order Z→A by skill name.

test_cases.scenario: Sort by created_at
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/?sort=created_at&order_by=ASC with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Skills are returned ordered oldest-first by creation date.

test_cases.scenario: Pagination: page and page_size params work
test_cases.steps: Ensure more than 5 skills exist. Send GET /api/v1/skills/?page=1&page_size=2 with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Exactly 2 skills are returned. pagination.page_size is 2. pagination.has_next is true if more skills exist.

test_cases.scenario: page_size is capped at 100
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/?page_size=999 with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: At most 100 results are returned. No error is raised.

test_cases.scenario: Empty list returns valid paginated response
test_cases.steps: Ensure no active skills exist. Send GET /api/v1/skills/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: results is an empty array. pagination.total_count is 0. HTTP 200.

test_cases.scenario: Response fields match list serializer schema
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Each skill object in results contains: code, skill, description, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by.

test_cases.scenario: Default ordering is alphabetical by skill name
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/ with no sort param.
test_cases.expected: Skills are returned in ascending alphabetical order by skill name.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/SKILL-0001/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without view_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/SKILL-0001/ with a valid token for a user without skills.view_skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Valid code returns skill detail with all fields
test_cases.steps: Ensure a skill exists with a known code. Send GET /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response data contains: code, skill, description, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by.

test_cases.scenario: Unknown code returns 404
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/UNKNOWN-9999/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404. Structured error response is returned. No stack trace is exposed.

test_cases.scenario: Inactive skill is retrievable by code
test_cases.steps: Ensure an inactive skill exists with a known code. Send GET /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Skill is returned with is_active=false.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with no Authorization header and a valid JSON body.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without add_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with a valid token for a user without skills.add_skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Valid payload creates skill and returns 201
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with body: {"skill": "Python", "description": "Core programming language", "is_active": true}. Include valid Bearer token with add_skill permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Response contains the created skill with code, skill, description, is_active=true, created_at, created_by.

test_cases.scenario: Duplicate skill name returns 409
test_cases.steps: Create a skill named 'Python'. Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with skill='Python' again.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 409. Response body contains error indicating a skill with that name already exists.

test_cases.scenario: Missing required skill field returns 400
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with body: {"description": "No skill name given"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error response references the skill field as required.

test_cases.scenario: Skill name exceeding 20 characters returns 400
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with skill set to a 21-character string.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error response indicates skill name is too long (max 20 chars).

test_cases.scenario: Description is optional and defaults to empty string
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with body: {"skill": "Java"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Created skill has description as an empty string.

test_cases.scenario: is_active is optional and defaults to true
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with body: {"skill": "Go"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Created skill has is_active=true.

test_cases.scenario: Creating skill with is_active=false creates inactive skill
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with body: {"skill": "COBOL", "is_active": false}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Response shows is_active=false.

test_cases.scenario: Created skill appears in list API immediately
test_cases.steps: Create a skill via POST. Then send GET /api/v1/skills/ with is_active=true.
test_cases.expected: The newly created skill appears in the list results.

test_cases.scenario: created_by is set to the authenticated user
test_cases.steps: Log in as a specific user. Create a skill via POST /api/v1/skills/. Retrieve the skill with GET /api/v1/skills/<code>/.
test_cases.expected: created_by in the response reflects the user who made the create request.

test_cases.scenario: Skill name with exactly 20 characters is accepted
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with skill set to exactly 20 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Skill is created successfully.

test_cases.scenario: Skill name with 21 characters is rejected
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with skill set to exactly 21 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error references the 20-character maximum for the skill field.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without change_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with a valid token for a user without skills.change_skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Valid partial update of skill name returns updated skill
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with body: {"skill": "Rust"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows the updated skill name. Other fields are unchanged.

test_cases.scenario: Updating description returns updated value
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with body: {"description": "Updated description"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows the updated description.

test_cases.scenario: Updating is_active via PATCH works
test_cases.steps: Create an active skill. Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with body: {"is_active": false}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows is_active=false.

test_cases.scenario: Renaming to a name that belongs to another skill returns 409
test_cases.steps: Ensure two skills exist: 'Python' and 'Java'. Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<Python code>/ with body: {"skill": "Java"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 409. Error indicates a skill with that name already exists.

test_cases.scenario: Updating a skill with its own current name does not conflict
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with body: {"skill": "<same name as skill>"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Update succeeds. No conflict error is raised.

test_cases.scenario: Updating unknown code returns 404
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/UNKNOWN-9999/ with a valid body and token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404.

test_cases.scenario: Skill name longer than 20 characters returns 400
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with skill set to 21 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error references the 20-character maximum.

test_cases.scenario: Empty PATCH body succeeds without modifying the skill
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with an empty JSON body {}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Skill data is unchanged. No error is returned.

test_cases.scenario: updated_by reflects the user who made the update
test_cases.steps: Log in as a specific user. Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with any valid change. Retrieve the skill.
test_cases.expected: updated_by in the response reflects the user who performed the update.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send DELETE /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without delete_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send DELETE /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with a valid token for a user without skills.delete_skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Valid delete returns 204
test_cases.steps: Ensure a skill with a known code exists. Send DELETE /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with a valid token and delete_skill permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 204. No response body.

test_cases.scenario: Unknown code returns 404
test_cases.steps: Send DELETE /api/v1/skills/UNKNOWN-9999/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404. Structured error response is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Deleted skill no longer appears in list
test_cases.steps: Create a skill. Delete it via DELETE. Then send GET /api/v1/skills/?is_active=false or active.
test_cases.expected: The deleted skill does not appear in any list response.

test_cases.scenario: Retrieve of deleted skill returns 404
test_cases.steps: Delete a skill. Then send GET /api/v1/skills/<code>/ for the deleted skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404.

test_cases.scenario: Deleted skill does not appear in options endpoint
test_cases.steps: Create and delete a skill. Send GET /api/v1/skills/options/.
test_cases.expected: The deleted skill is absent from the options list.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/<code>/activate/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without change_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/<code>/activate/ with a valid token for a user without skills.change_skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Activating an inactive skill sets is_active to true
test_cases.steps: Ensure a skill with is_active=false exists. Send POST /api/v1/skills/<code>/activate/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows is_active=true. Skill now appears in default list and options.

test_cases.scenario: Activating an already-active skill is a no-op
test_cases.steps: Ensure a skill with is_active=true exists. Send POST /api/v1/skills/<code>/activate/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows is_active=true. No error is raised.

test_cases.scenario: Activating unknown code returns 404
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/UNKNOWN-9999/activate/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404.

test_cases.scenario: Activated skill appears in default (active-only) list and options
test_cases.steps: Deactivate a skill. Activate it. Send GET /api/v1/skills/ and GET /api/v1/skills/options/.
test_cases.expected: The skill appears in both the active list and the options list.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/<code>/deactivate/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without change_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/<code>/deactivate/ with a valid token for a user without skills.change_skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivating an active skill sets is_active to false
test_cases.steps: Ensure a skill with is_active=true exists. Send POST /api/v1/skills/<code>/deactivate/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows is_active=false.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivating an already-inactive skill is a no-op
test_cases.steps: Ensure a skill with is_active=false exists. Send POST /api/v1/skills/<code>/deactivate/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows is_active=false. No error is raised.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivating unknown code returns 404
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/UNKNOWN-9999/deactivate/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivated skill excluded from default list
test_cases.steps: Deactivate a skill. Send GET /api/v1/skills/ (default active-only).
test_cases.expected: The deactivated skill is not included in the results.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivated skill excluded from options list
test_cases.steps: Deactivate a skill. Send GET /api/v1/skills/options/.
test_cases.expected: The deactivated skill does not appear in the options response.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivated skill appears when filtering is_active=false
test_cases.steps: Deactivate a skill. Send GET /api/v1/skills/?is_active=false.
test_cases.expected: The deactivated skill appears in the results.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/stats/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without view_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/stats/ with a valid token for a user without skills.view_skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Statistics returns total, active, and inactive counts
test_cases.steps: Ensure a known set of active and inactive skills exists. Send GET /api/v1/skills/stats/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response contains total, active, and inactive counts that match the current state.

test_cases.scenario: Statistics are accurate after create and deactivate operations
test_cases.steps: Note current stats. Create one active skill and deactivate one existing skill. Send GET /api/v1/skills/stats/ again.
test_cases.expected: total increases by 1, active and inactive counts update to reflect the operations.

test_cases.scenario: fields param returns only requested stat keys
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/stats/?fields=active,inactive with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response contains only the active and inactive keys, not total.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/options/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without view_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/options/ with a valid token for a user without skills.view_skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Options returns only active skills
test_cases.steps: Ensure active and inactive skills exist. Send GET /api/v1/skills/options/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response list contains only active skills. Inactive skills are absent.

test_cases.scenario: Each option entry contains code and skill fields only
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/options/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Each item in the response has code and skill fields. No extra fields (description, created_at, etc.) are included.

test_cases.scenario: Newly created skill appears in options immediately
test_cases.steps: Create a new active skill. Send GET /api/v1/skills/options/.
test_cases.expected: The new skill appears in the options list.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivated skill is removed from options
test_cases.steps: Deactivate a skill. Send GET /api/v1/skills/options/.
test_cases.expected: The deactivated skill is no longer present in the options response.

test_cases.scenario: Options returns empty list when no active skills exist
test_cases.steps: Ensure all skills are inactive or none exist. Send GET /api/v1/skills/options/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response is an empty array.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without import_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/ with a valid token for a user without skills.import_skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Valid CSV with header and data rows imports successfully
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV file with header row 'skill,description,is_active' and two valid data rows. Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. Response shows created_rows list with both skills. errors is empty. Skills are visible in GET /api/v1/skills/.

test_cases.scenario: No file uploaded returns 400
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/ with a valid token but no file in the request body.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates no import file was uploaded.

test_cases.scenario: Non-CSV file returns 400
test_cases.steps: Upload a .xlsx or .txt file to POST /api/v1/skills/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates unsupported file format and lists allowed formats (csv only).

test_cases.scenario: Missing required 'skill' column in CSV returns 400
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV file with only a 'description' column header (no 'skill' column). Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates the 'skill' column is missing.

test_cases.scenario: Row with blank skill name is skipped and reported in errors
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV with one valid row and one row where the skill cell is blank. Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. The valid row is created. The blank skill row appears in errors with field=skill and message about skill being required.

test_cases.scenario: Row with skill name exceeding 20 characters is skipped and reported in errors
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV with a row where the skill value is 21 characters. Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. The oversized skill name row appears in errors indicating 20-character maximum. No skill is created for that row.

test_cases.scenario: Row with duplicate skill name is skipped and reported in errors
test_cases.steps: Ensure a skill named 'Python' already exists. Upload a CSV containing a row with skill='Python'. Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. The duplicate row appears in errors. No new skill is created for that row.

test_cases.scenario: File exceeding 5 MB size limit returns 400
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV file larger than 5 MB. Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates the file is too large and shows the maximum allowed size.

test_cases.scenario: File with more than 1000 data rows returns 400
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV file with 1001 data rows. Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates too many rows and shows the maximum allowed (1000).

test_cases.scenario: Dry run (validate=true) previews result without creating skills
test_cases.steps: Upload a valid CSV. Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/?validate=true.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. Response shows dry_run=true, created_rows previewed, but no skills are actually created. GET /api/v1/skills/ does not show any new skills.

test_cases.scenario: CSV row with is_active=false creates an inactive skill
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV with a row: skill='COBOL',description='',is_active=false.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. The skill is created. GET /api/v1/skills/?is_active=false confirms it as inactive.

test_cases.scenario: CSV row with only skill column creates skill with default values
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV with header 'skill' only and a row with just a skill name (≤20 chars).
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. Skill is created. description defaults to empty string, is_active defaults to true.

test_cases.scenario: GET /api/v1/skills/import/specs/ returns field definitions and limits
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/import/specs/ with a valid token and import_skill permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response contains supported_formats (['csv']), max_rows (1000), max_file_size_mb (5), fields array describing skill/description/is_active columns, and notes array.

test_cases.scenario: GET /api/v1/skills/import/sample/ downloads a CSV template
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/import/sample/ with a valid token and import_skill permission.
test_cases.expected: Response is a CSV file download (skills_import_template.csv) with header row: skill,description,is_active and a sample data row.

test_cases.scenario: Import response includes accurate total row count
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV with 5 rows (3 valid, 1 duplicate, 1 blank skill). Send POST /api/v1/skills/import/.
test_cases.expected: Response total is 5. created_rows has 3 entries. errors has 2 entries.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without export_skill returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/ with a valid token for a user without skills.export_skill.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Export as CSV returns a downloadable CSV file
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=csv with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response content-type is text/csv. File is downloadable. Contains a header row and data rows for all active skills.

test_cases.scenario: Export as XLSX returns a downloadable Excel file
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=xlsx with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response is an XLSX file. It can be opened in Excel/Google Sheets and contains skill data.

test_cases.scenario: Export as PDF returns a downloadable PDF file
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=pdf with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response is a PDF file containing skills data in a readable format.

test_cases.scenario: Export as JSON returns a downloadable JSON file
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=json with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response is a JSON file containing skill records.

test_cases.scenario: Unsupported export format returns 400
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=xml with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates unsupported format and lists allowed values: csv, xlsx, pdf, json.

test_cases.scenario: fields param filters exported columns
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=csv&fields=skill,code with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Exported CSV contains only 'skill' and 'code' columns. Other columns are absent.

test_cases.scenario: Default export includes only active skills
test_cases.steps: Ensure both active and inactive skills exist. Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=csv with no is_active filter.
test_cases.expected: Exported file contains only active skills.

test_cases.scenario: is_active=all exports both active and inactive skills
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=csv&is_active=all with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Exported CSV contains both active and inactive skills.

test_cases.scenario: search filter in export matches list filter behavior
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=csv&search=Python with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Exported file contains only skills whose skill name matches 'Python'.

test_cases.scenario: GET /api/v1/skills/export/specs/ returns available column definitions
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/specs/ with a valid token and export_skill permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response contains a columns array with entries for skill, code, description, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by — each with key, label, and default.

test_cases.scenario: Export with no matching skills returns file with headers only
test_cases.steps: Apply a search filter that matches no skills. Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=csv&search=ZZZNOMATCH.
test_cases.expected: Exported CSV contains the header row only, no data rows.

test_cases.scenario: Default exported columns match export specs default=true columns
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/export/?type=csv with no fields param.
test_cases.expected: Exported CSV headers match the columns where default=true in export specs: skill, code, description, is_active, created_at.

test_cases.scenario: All skill endpoints require a valid Bearer token
test_cases.steps: Send requests to all endpoints (list, retrieve, options, create, update, delete, activate, deactivate, stats, import, export) with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: All return HTTP 401. No endpoint is accessible without authentication.

test_cases.scenario: Invalid Bearer token returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/ with Authorization: Bearer invalidtoken123.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Correct permission is enforced per endpoint
test_cases.steps: Use a user with only view_skill. Attempt POST /api/v1/skills/ (create), PATCH (update), DELETE, activate, deactivate, import, export.
test_cases.expected: All write/import/export endpoints return HTTP 403. list, retrieve, stats, and options succeed.

test_cases.scenario: Error responses do not expose internal stack traces
test_cases.steps: Trigger a 404 and a 400 error on any skill endpoint.
test_cases.expected: Error response contains only code and message. No stack trace, SQL query, or internal file path is visible.

test_cases.scenario: Response fields do not include unexpected sensitive data
test_cases.steps: Retrieve any skill via GET /api/v1/skills/<code>/.
test_cases.expected: Response contains only documented fields: code, skill, description, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by. No internal DB fields or system fields are exposed.

test_cases.scenario: Audit log is created on create, update, delete, activate, deactivate
test_cases.steps: Perform create, update, delete, activate, and deactivate operations on a skill. Check the audit log.
test_cases.expected: Each operation generates an audit record with the correct module (skills), resource type (skill), resource code, before/after state, and actor.

test_cases.scenario: Skill name with exactly 20 characters (boundary) is accepted
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with a skill name of exactly 20 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Skill is created successfully. Name is stored as provided.

test_cases.scenario: Skill name with 21 characters (boundary +1) is rejected on create
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with a skill name of exactly 21 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error references the 20-character limit.

test_cases.scenario: Skill name with 21 characters (boundary +1) is rejected on update
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/skills/<code>/ with a skill name of exactly 21 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error references the 20-character limit.

test_cases.scenario: Skill name with special characters is accepted
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with skill: 'C++' (3 chars).
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Skill is created and the name is stored exactly as provided.

test_cases.scenario: Skill name with unicode characters is accepted within 20-char limit
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with a unicode skill name of ≤20 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Skill is created with the unicode name intact.

test_cases.scenario: Description can be an empty string on create
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with body: {"skill": "Rust", "description": ""}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Skill created with empty description.

test_cases.scenario: Description can be set to empty string on update
test_cases.steps: Create a skill with a non-empty description. Then PATCH it with description: ''.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Updated skill has empty description.

test_cases.scenario: Sorting by an unsupported field does not crash the API
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/?sort=nonexistent_field with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Returns skills with default ordering. No 500 error.

test_cases.scenario: page=0 is treated as page 1
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/?page=0 with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Returns the first page of results. No error.

test_cases.scenario: Non-numeric page or page_size is handled gracefully
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/skills/?page=abc&page_size=xyz with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Falls back to default page=1, page_size=25. No error.

test_cases.scenario: Importing a CSV with BOM encoding is handled correctly
test_cases.steps: Save a CSV file with UTF-8 BOM encoding containing valid skill rows. Upload it via POST /api/v1/skills/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. BOM is stripped. Skills are created correctly. No missing column error.

test_cases.scenario: Concurrent create requests with the same skill name results in only one skill created
test_cases.steps: Simultaneously send two POST /api/v1/skills/ requests with the same skill name.
test_cases.expected: One request succeeds with HTTP 201. The other returns HTTP 409. Only one skill with that name exists in the system.

test_cases.scenario: Skill name with only whitespace is treated as blank and rejected
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/skills/ with skill: '   ' (whitespace only).
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400 or HTTP 207 (if via import). The skill is not created. An error is returned referencing the skill field.
